## 主张 Claim

设 next : S → S 是任意类型 S 上的确定的律，轨道 Law.orbit。区域 R 在 next 下吸收，是指 R s 推出 R (next s)（Law.Absorbing）；s 被吸入 R，是指 ¬ R s 且某一步 R (orbit next s n)（Law.DrawnInto）；s 被吸入，是指有吸收区域把它吸入（Law.Drawn）；s 的前方是从 next s 起轨道上的配置（Law.Ahead）。前方吸收（Law.absorbing_ahead）；轨道进入吸收区域之后每一步都在其中（Law.Absorbing.orbit）；s 返回恰当 s 在自己的前方（Law.returns_iff_ahead）。锁定：R 吸收、¬ R s、R (orbit next s n) 时，对每个 k，orbit next s (n + k) ≠ s（Law.DrawnInto.never_back），所以被吸入的配置不返回（Law.Drawn.not_returns）。主律，不加前提、不用有限性与可判定性：Drawn next s ↔ ¬ Returns next s（Law.drawn_iff_not_returns）；不返回的 s 被吸入自己的前方，在第一步进入（Law.drawnInto_ahead）。未来收窄：Reachable next n 吸收（Law.reachable_absorbing）；n 步后不可得的 s 被吸入 Reachable next n，在第 n 步进入（Law.reachable_orbit、Law.lost_drawn），所以被吸入（Law.drawn_of_lost）；返回者吸收（Law.returning_absorbing）。合并：x ≠ y、next x = next y 时 ¬ (Returns next x ∧ Returns next y)，不需要有限性（Law.Merges.not_both_return，经 Law.periods_meet：a + (a + 1)·b = b + (b + 1)·a）；所以 ¬ (¬ Drawn next x ∧ ¬ Drawn next y)（Law.merge_draws），合并的律有 ¬¬ ∃ s, Drawn next s（Law.Merges.draws）；没有配置被吸入时，next x = next y 推出 ¬ x ≠ y（Law.none_drawn_merges_nothing），相等可判定时律不合并（Law.none_drawn_lossless）。列表持有每个配置时：被吸入推出不是 Lossless、不是 KeepsPossibilities（Law.Drawn.not_lossless、Law.Lossless.not_drawn、Law.Drawn.not_keeps）；相等可判定时 Lossless next ↔ ∀ s, ¬ Drawn next s（Law.lossless_iff_none_drawn）；Returns next s ↔ ∀ n, Reachable next n s（Law.returns_iff_always_reachable），所以 Drawn next s ↔ ¬ ∀ n, Reachable next n s（Law.drawn_iff_lost，从右到左不需要列表）；每条轨道进入一个返回的配置（Law.enters_returning），所以不返回的配置被吸入返回者的区域（Law.drawnInto_returning）。开放的见证：Drawn Nat.succ 0 ∧ Lossless Nat.succ（Law.succ_drawn_lossless）；Drawn Nat.pred 1 ∧ KeepsPossibilities Nat.pred（Law.pred_drawn_keeps，经 Law.pred_orbit_zero）。过程：Absorbing next R ↔ Invariant (Law.process next) R（Law.absorbing_iff_invariant）；R 在动作 a 下吸收（AbsorbingUnder）；Invariant P R ↔ ∀ a, AbsorbingUnder P R a（invariant_iff_every_move）；不变的 R、R t、¬ R s 时 ¬ Reach P t s（Invariant.locks_out）；运行 r 在第 n 步于不变的 R 内、第 m 步在 R 外时，对每个 k，r.state (n + k) ≠ r.state m（Run.locked_in）；从第 n 步起每个动作都保持 R 时运行留在 R 中（Run.stays）；R (r.state n) 而 ¬ R (r.state (n + 1)) 时，第 n 步的动作不保持 R（Run.leaving_needs）。Ratchet 中每个配置都到 true：律合并 false 与 true，{true} 吸收，false 被吸入它而不返回，也在一步后不可得，true 返回而不被吸入（Ratchet.merges、absorbing、false_drawn、false_never_returns、false_lost、true_returns、true_not_drawn）。Exit 中动作 false 保持配置、动作 true 翻转它：{true} 在 false 下吸收、在 true 下不吸收，所以不是不变量；只取 false 的运行留在 {true} 中；离开的运行第一步所取的动作不保持 {true}（Exit.keeps、leaves、not_invariant、locked_in、leaving_takes）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let next : S → S be a determined law on a type S of any kind, with orbit Law.orbit. A region R is absorbing under next when R s gives R (next s) (Law.Absorbing); s is drawn into R when ¬ R s and R (orbit next s n) at some step (Law.DrawnInto); s is drawn when some absorbing region draws it (Law.Drawn); what lies ahead of s is the course from next s on (Law.Ahead). What lies ahead is absorbing (Law.absorbing_ahead); once the course is in an absorbing region it is in it at every later step (Law.Absorbing.orbit); s returns exactly where it lies ahead of itself (Law.returns_iff_ahead). Lock-in: with R absorbing, ¬ R s and R (orbit next s n), orbit next s (n + k) ≠ s for every k (Law.DrawnInto.never_back), so a drawn configuration never returns (Law.Drawn.not_returns). The main law, with no premise, no finiteness and no decidability: Drawn next s ↔ ¬ Returns next s (Law.drawn_iff_not_returns); an s that does not return is drawn into what lies ahead of it, entering at the first step (Law.drawnInto_ahead). The future narrows: Reachable next n is absorbing (Law.reachable_absorbing); an s that cannot be had n steps on is drawn into Reachable next n, entering at step n (Law.reachable_orbit, Law.lost_drawn), so it is drawn (Law.drawn_of_lost); what returns is absorbing (Law.returning_absorbing). Merging: where x ≠ y and next x = next y, ¬ (Returns next x ∧ Returns next y), with no finiteness (Law.Merges.not_both_return, through Law.periods_meet: a + (a + 1)·b = b + (b + 1)·a); so ¬ (¬ Drawn next x ∧ ¬ Drawn next y) (Law.merge_draws), and a law that merges has ¬¬ ∃ s, Drawn next s (Law.Merges.draws); where nothing is drawn, next x = next y gives ¬ x ≠ y (Law.none_drawn_merges_nothing), and with decidable equality the law merges nothing (Law.none_drawn_lossless). Where a list holds every configuration: being drawn rules out Lossless and KeepsPossibilities (Law.Drawn.not_lossless, Law.Lossless.not_drawn, Law.Drawn.not_keeps); with decidable equality, Lossless next ↔ ∀ s, ¬ Drawn next s (Law.lossless_iff_none_drawn); Returns next s ↔ ∀ n, Reachable next n s (Law.returns_iff_always_reachable), so Drawn next s ↔ ¬ ∀ n, Reachable next n s (Law.drawn_iff_lost, right to left with no list); every course enters a configuration that returns (Law.enters_returning), so a configuration that does not return is drawn into what returns (Law.drawnInto_returning). Open witnesses: Drawn Nat.succ 0 ∧ Lossless Nat.succ (Law.succ_drawn_lossless); Drawn Nat.pred 1 ∧ KeepsPossibilities Nat.pred (Law.pred_drawn_keeps, through Law.pred_orbit_zero). Processes: Absorbing next R ↔ Invariant (Law.process next) R (Law.absorbing_iff_invariant); R is absorbing under the move a (AbsorbingUnder); Invariant P R ↔ ∀ a, AbsorbingUnder P R a (invariant_iff_every_move); with R invariant, R t and ¬ R s, ¬ Reach P t s (Invariant.locks_out); where a run r is inside an invariant R at step n and outside it at step m, r.state (n + k) ≠ r.state m for every k (Run.locked_in); where every move from step n on keeps R, the run stays in R (Run.stays); where R (r.state n) and ¬ R (r.state (n + 1)), the move at step n does not keep R (Run.leaving_needs). In Ratchet every configuration goes to true: the law merges false and true, {true} is absorbing, false is drawn into it, never returns and cannot be had one step on, and true returns and is not drawn (Ratchet.merges, absorbing, false_drawn, false_never_returns, false_lost, true_returns, true_not_drawn). In Exit the move false keeps the configuration and the move true flips it: {true} is absorbing under false and not under true, so it is not invariant; the run that only moves false stays in {true}; the run that leaves takes, at its first step, a move that does not keep {true} (Exit.keeps, leaves, not_invariant, locked_in, leaving_takes). No Lean axiom is used.
